presets.title: Quick Presets
presets.speed_tooltip:
All optimizations enabled, fastest speed
(May have slight precision trade-offs)
presets.balanced_tooltip:
Best balance of speed and accuracy
(Recommended for most users)
presets.quality_tooltip:
All comparisons, maximum precision
(Slower but 100% accurate)

audio.title: Audio Fingerprinting (Primary Filter)
audio.threshold_tooltip:
Videos with audio similarity below this threshold are rejected
Lower = More candidates (slower but catches more)
Higher = Fewer candidates (faster but may miss some)
Recommended: 70%
audio.precision_tooltip:
Fast: Quick extraction, good for most cases
Balanced: Better precision, moderate speed
Maximum: Best precision, slower
audio.workers_tooltip: Number of parallel workers for audio extraction
audio.cache_size_tooltip: Maximum audio fingerprints to cache in memory
audio.fallback: Enable fallback for videos without audio
audio.fallback_tooltip:
If enabled, videos without audio will be compared using video hashing only
If disabled, videos without audio will be skipped
audio.info:
Audio fingerprinting filters 85-90% of video pairs before video comparison.
Requires fpcalc (chromaprint): brew install chromaprint (macOS) or apt install chromaprint-tools (Linux)

lsh.title: LSH (Locality Sensitive Hashing)
lsh.enable_tooltip:
LSH reduces O(N²) comparisons to O(N·k) by grouping similar items
Provides 20-50x speedup on large datasets
lsh.bands_tooltip: More bands = More buckets = Better precision but slower
lsh.rows_tooltip: More rows = Stricter matching = Fewer false positives
lsh.no_audio_tooltip: Apply LSH optimization to videos without audio
lsh.info:
LSH groups similar fingerprints into buckets, comparing only within buckets.
Example: 1000 videos → 499,500 pairs reduced to ~40,000 pairs (90% reduction)

multi_resolution.title: Multi-Resolution Comparison
multi_resolution.enable_tooltip:
Compare audio progressively: short sample → medium → full
Provides 2-3x speedup by rejecting early
multi_resolution.coarse_threshold_tooltip: Reject if quick test is below this threshold
multi_resolution.medium_threshold_tooltip: Reject if medium test is below this threshold
multi_resolution.info:
Progressive filtering: Most pairs rejected in coarse phase (fastest),
fewer reach medium phase, only best candidates get full comparison.

metadata.title: Metadata Quick Filter (Optional)
metadata.enable_tooltip:
⚠️ WARNING: May create false negatives if videos are re-encoded!
Filters by duration and file size before audio comparison.
Only enable if you're sure videos have not been re-encoded.
metadata.duration_tolerance_tooltip: Reject if duration difference > this percentage
metadata.size_ratio_tooltip: Reject if size ratio < this value
metadata.warning:
⚠️ Metadata filter can miss re-encoded duplicates with different sizes/durations.
Only enable if you need maximum speed and are sure videos are identical copies.

video_hash.title: Video Hashing (Selective)
video_hash.method_tooltip:
pHash: Most accurate (DCT-based), ~1s per video
dHash: Good balance (gradient-based), ~0.5s per video
aHash: Fastest (average-based), ~0.2s per video
video_hash.workers_tooltip:
Number of parallel threads for video hashing
More = Faster (uses more CPU/RAM)
Recommended: 60-100% of your CPUs
Auto-optimized: Detected based on your CPU
video_hash.timeout_tooltip: Timeout per video for hash computation
video_hash.cache_size_tooltip: Maximum video hashes to cache in memory
video_hash.info:
Videos are hashed ONLY if their audio similarity is above threshold.
Selective hashing saves 70-90% of video processing time!

video_comparison.title: Video Comparison
video_comparison.threshold_tooltip:
Videos with similarity above this threshold are marked as duplicates
Recommended: 90%
video_comparison.flip_detection_tooltip:
Detect videos that are horizontally flipped (mirrored)
Common on social media to avoid copyright detection
video_comparison.workers_tooltip:
Number of parallel threads for video comparison
More = Much faster (uses more CPU)
Recommended: 100% of your CPUs
Auto-optimized: Detected based on your CPU
